name: browser-workflow-profiles
goal: Profile one actual browser workflow and its settled renderer heap without borrowing a previous navigation or replaying the action

evidence: NavigationTiming correctly rejects soft destinations, leaving completed browser workflows without runtime profiles. The existing collector has no action boundary and never invokes a supplied workflow.

Extend the same seven-case page-workload protocol with execute-once, failed-action and evidence-off cases. Protocol numbers stay isolated and removed; actual app observations must come from the real browser workload.
Sealed be16166f at 73d27fc79: old navigation capture never executes the workflow callback, including when evidence is off; failed-action control also exposes an incorrect success.

The Harness adapter measures one actual action with zero warmups or replays, then reads settled browser heap and build identity. It preserves execute-once behavior when evidence is off and records no success on rejection.
Sealed unchanged ten-case corpus: 80e2169e red and a1e1b450 green at 13c45ac51. Prior navigation refusal and inspector cleanup cases remain passing.
